about.text: The fat left in whey, spun off in a separator: a cream of usually 25–30 % fat, against about 40 % for milk cream. It can go back into the cheese milk, or be churned into whey butter.

links.name: Tetra Pak Dairy Processing Handbook, ch. Whey processing

facts.v: Saltier, tangier and cheesier than sweet cream
